name: Philips Videopac+ G7400
description: Philips' 1983 European successor to the Videopac G7000 (Odyssey²), adding a second video chipset for higher-resolution backgrounds while keeping compatibility with older cartridges. A North American version, the Odyssey³, was shown but never released.
curiosities: The Odyssey³ was shown at the 1983 Winter CES as the 'Odyssey Command Center' with a planned $199 price, then cancelled.
Thomson-Brandt sold a licensed French version called the Jopac (JO 7400).
Most G7000 cartridges run on it, and some later cartridges show enhanced backgrounds when played on the G7400.
It added Thomson's EF9340 and EF9341 video chips, which drew teletext-style graphics over the G7000's.
